# PanePilot v0.19.0

PanePilot 0.19.0 improves SSH terminal creation and renaming, adds optional idle-chat power saving, and makes completed Actions easier to notice.

- Create terminals with bounded session-name checks, and see SSH failures instead
  of getting stuck checking names. Rename the exact tmux session safely even when
  another PanePilot client has already changed its name.
- Enable **Power saving** to pause eligible idle chats on this Mac, with a timeout
  and minimum number of chats to keep open. Reopen a saved chat to resume it. Hold
  or right-click the status-bar leaf to configure it and inspect separate memory
  estimates for Electron, tmux, and agent processes. Power saving is off by default.
- See a brief **Run complete** pill above Actions when a project command succeeds,
  without losing keyboard focus.

## Update or download

In PanePilot v0.16.0 or newer, open **More toolbar actions → Check for updates…**,
then use **Restart to update** after saving your drafts. Installation is never
automatic. Earlier public releases require one manual installation from the DMG
or ZIP. For the SSH fixes, update the Mac running the PanePilot interface; the
remote host does not need a PanePilot update just to receive tmux commands.

The downloads support Apple silicon Macs running macOS 12 or newer. They are ad-hoc
signed and not Apple-notarized; Sparkle signatures verify updates, not Apple
developer identity. Verify downloads with the attached `SHA256SUMS.txt`.

Persistent tmux sessions remain available for reconnection. Plain PTY terminals do
not survive app exit, and SSH port forwards must be reopened after restarting.
